about_the_game:
Beekeeper Simulator lets you step into the peaceful yet rewarding world of beekeeping. Start small with a single hive, tending to your bees by providing food, cleaning the hives, and keeping them healthy. As your colonies grow, gather different types of honey based on the flowers your bees visit, each with unique flavors and values.

Use your earnings to buy better tools, new hives, and advanced equipment to improve honey production. Explore the environment to find rare flowers, attract special bee species, and optimize your apiary. Expand your beekeeping empire, manage multiple hives, and master the art of honey-making while keeping your bees happy and productive.

short_description: Beekeeper Simulator puts you in the shoes of a dedicated beekeeper, where you'll care for buzzing hives, harvest a variety of honey types, and expand your operations to build a thriving beekeeping empire. Nurture your bees, optimize your apiary, and turn your passion into profit!
